# Issue #1415 完整结构化证据

本记录以固定 APP354f / driverf363 的生产 run42323706132 为最终功能验收：四段业务、要求的清理和最后部署核验均通过。截止资源观察为2026-11-07 01:37:09 UTC，两台任务Docker stopped；控制VM仍用于收尾。

`finalProductionCompletion` 和 `finalCompletionFields` 表示本次结论。`closeoutUpdates`、旧回执及保留的 pending/failed 字段是其各自时间与版本的历史，不被最终成功覆盖。本文档自身后续PR、CI、merge、main Web发布与控制VM停止由Issue最终评论另记，未提前宣称完成。

输入JSON的SHA256：`374efec6e6f753104c2a491379e4b430fc486ac0df98b38c9b7f555772496964`。下面代码块完整保留该JSON的UTF-8字节（含末尾换行），不是摘要。用户证据入口和各项限制见 [验收报告](final-report.md)。

              "deploymentBindingVerified": false

            "statementCount": 3,
            "selectStatementCount": 1,
            "readOnlyTransaction": true,
            "sqlWrites": 0,
            "sql": "WITH owned AS (\n  SELECT w.id, w.name, w.\"userId\", w.\"createdAt\",\n    encode(sha256(convert_to('team-workspace','UTF8') || decode('00','hex') || convert_to(w.id::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS team_hash,\n    encode(sha256(convert_to('workspace-owner','UTF8') || decode('00','hex') || convert_to(w.\"userId\",'UTF8')),'hex') AS owner_hash\n  FROM mikka_workspaces w\n  JOIN mikka_workspace_members m ON m.\"workspaceId\"=w.id AND m.\"userId\"=w.\"userId\"\n  WHERE w.kind='team' AND m.role='admin' AND m.status='active'\n    AND encode(sha256(convert_to(lower(btrim(m.email)),'UTF8')),'hex')='0049e13c050f799070a7d1a95bb843f2a0519b5e8732bf6986e2e1613b8941c3'\n)\nSELECT current_database() AS source_database,\n  current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS transaction_read_only,\n  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM owned) AS matching_owned_team_count,\n  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n    'teamWorkspaceHash', x.team_hash,\n    'creatorIdentityHash', x.owner_hash,\n    'name', CASE WHEN x.name ~ '[@[:cntrl:]]' THEN NULL ELSE x.name END,\n    'createdAt', x.\"createdAt\",\n    'memberCount', (SELECT count(*)::int FROM mikka_workspace_members mm WHERE mm.\"workspaceId\"=x.id),\n    'activeAdminCount', (SELECT count(*)::int FROM mikka_workspace_members mm WHERE mm.\"workspaceId\"=x.id AND mm.role='admin' AND mm.status='active')\n  )) FROM (SELECT * FROM owned LIMIT 33) x), '[]'::jsonb) AS teams;",
            "result": {
              "source_database": "orvilo_mvp",
              "transaction_read_only": "on",
              "matching_owned_team_count": 2,
